tagline: Walk-over and drive-over lines of light, straight or curved.
description: Inground Radius is an in-ground linear luminaire for drawing continuous lines of light into paving, plazas and along façades. Straight and curved pieces, from a tight 272mm radius to a gentle 6.1m sweep, let a single line follow paths and planting edges. The marine-grade stainless steel body is drive-over rated to 5,000kg.
specification: In-ground linear luminaire. Marine-grade 316L stainless steel housing. Opal encapsulated cover. IP67. IK10. Drive-over up to 5000kg. CRI>90. 3-step MacAdam. L90B10 60000h. 24V DC (FL56, 56 LEDs/m: 2.4 | 4.8 | 9.6W/m) | 48V DC (FL112, 112 LEDs/m: 4.8 | 9.6W/m), driver sold separately. Operating temperature -25°C to +50°C. Straight and curved segments: individual, full, start, middle and end pieces for continuous lines.

tagline: Pixel-controlled colour for moving light effects in the ground.
description: Inground Radius Pixel RGBW uses an addressable RGBW strip, so colour and white can move along the line for chases, gradients and animated effects. It keeps the stainless steel, drive-over profile and the straight and curved pieces of the range. White light is mixed across roughly 1800K to 6500K.
specification: In-ground linear luminaire, pixel-addressable RGBW. Marine-grade 316L stainless steel housing. Opal encapsulated cover. IP67. IK10. Drive-over up to 5000kg.
